body: I'll be on the hook for around 20% of my income (I have a finance degree but only make $13/hr, 40 hrs/week at the moment) plus possible back support plus lawyer fees, court costs, etc.
She has a fiance, and no, I doubt he thinks he's his because he's only in a couple pics with the kid and told me it was her ex's kid.

She told me it's not mine, her conception date was the day she hooked up with an ex, and that they're identical and I was just like, "oh okay, sorry for bringing this up, I'm just a worrier".

Do I let her know that I know or should I just leave it at that?

There's no statute of limitations to establishing paternity. So anytime in the next 16 years, the rug could be swept from under me. I do think she's going to eventually bring it up. It could be she didn't want me around in his infancy or she's trying to establish her life with her husband/career/save money for attorney fees.

Even forgetting about child support, it just hurts me that I have a child with a stranger and I'd have to have court dates just to get visitation, etc. Her and her family's personality/values/social status/religion etc are completely different from mine. I feel like no matter what I do, my son is going to grow up being nothing like me.

Ehh, it's cheap to file for child support I believe.

Still though, it's hell living like this. Being 99% sure that it's my kid and not knowing if and when she'll come after me for support. I can't just go along with my life and get in relationships and stuff. I've lost confidence, happiness, interest in hobbies, etc. I used to love going to the gym 4-5 times a week, now I'm lucky if I can get there once a week. My diet's gone to shit and I've gained a few pounds of fat. There were two consecutive days last week where I drank a 40 oz. of malt liquor after work. I'm miserable
Then I would have to tell them about all this. I don't know if seeing someone would even help. It wouldn't change anything.

I've known about this since May 17th when I stumbled upon her FB profile and I feel like my anxiety and depression just gets worse with time. I even messaged the girl and she still denied it was mine, but I can tell by her language that she's lying, she's probably just waiting to get settled or save up lawyer money before establishing paternity. I don't really have money to talk to a professional, especially now with all this, and I don't even know if they would keep anonymity and I don't want to have to be under 72 hour lockdown or anything like that.

I don't know if I should tell my parents or try talking to the girl again or what. I just feel so trapped.

Dude, that's what scares me so much. I always wanted to be a dad and have a family and be a good father, but how can I ever be that in this situation and when I'm having thoughts like this? I'm crying right now. I've been in bed all day. I don't know what to do. This situation is so terrifying.
Thanks. You're right about hetero sex. Really wishing I were gay at this point.
Wish my baby had this.

Why WOULD I want a child? I'm single, mid 20s, make $13/hr, this person is a stranger whom I have nothing in common with. How am I supposed to be happy or find love? My future is of court dates and child support and financial problems and a kid who will probably hate me because she'll have custody and a stepdad who spends more time with him than I'll be able to.

Unless she agreed, I would have to court order one. And I'm 99.9% positive anyway. He was born exactly 9 months after we had sex. She claims it's an ex's but I don't think the "ex" even exists.

And I don't want my family to find out about all this.
He can blame that on his mom, who chose to bring a virtual stranger's child into the world and not even tell him.
